name: glow-points-scene
title: Glow Points Scene
description: A glow points scene renders a luminous point-cloud stage for knowledge graphs, constellations, and ambient data backdrops. The wrapper keeps three.js behind a dynamic import, checks WebGL support up front, and falls back to a static notice when the context is unavailable — the scene is an enhancement, never a gate. Rendering only; hover/raycast interaction is the consumer's concern.
